notes.title: Shallow Multilanguage Support
notes.content: The dictionary translation method provides shallow multi-language support. It is available in nine languages including Russian, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Japanese, Polish, Turkish and Korean.

notes.title: The Tailflames are Weapons
notes.content:
A pair of ship engines were added as weapons.
They will alternate bursts according to the rhythm of the music, taking advantage of this to hit high damage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42780808/3ef264623a08c092746d65533b3cadaae3918c16.png[/img]

notes.title: Fun Way
notes.content:
Added ships that can build blocks as weapons.
Ships will use emoticons to tell you their power output.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42780808/e94c21b593b03b8e5494e42c6c0189cde1182d9c.png[/img]

notes.title: Music Storm
notes.content:
Expand the music library to 100
Optimized the map editor and re-edited all the maps.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42780808/49e314109684c652a9c9552d4d3cd75fb3d9b67c.png[/img]

notes.title: Forget Ammo, Just Fire!
notes.content:
Added pistols as weapons.
Follow the rhythm and pull the trigger. Boom! Baaaah! Baaaah! Baaaah!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42780808/0bd0961b3759a5469ce1f901ddfda65f99bdef66.png[/img]

notes.title: What Big Fists
notes.content:
Added fists as weapons.
Shake those fists like a giant!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42780808/5b2ecca2d7feed40a716997c608684d9e7e8d8e8.png[/img]

notes.title: The Engulfing and Erupting of Black Hole
notes.content:
Added rings as weapons.
The black hole at the center of the ring ejects high-energy particles as it swallows the spacecraft.
Stabilizing the jet direction is critical.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42780808/44920ccfe9b4e32a7c5e442002186329aa124d4a.png[/img]

notes.title: Whip
notes.content:
Added whip as a weapon.
The chaotic swing of the whip can disturb space to create a magnetic field. The ship that enters the magnetic field will greatly reduce its speed and accept your lash.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42780808/007707401f02a6797e7ba1bb797d2d7e516d9d9c.png[/img]

notes.title: Cold Weapon Skins
notes.content:
Lots of art improvements.
Blue lightsaber, red Grand Sword, and orange backhand sword all have added Cold weapon skins (unlocked with the corresponding character)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42780808/e5410e1ef99656e427e873bc9ee26b9628895ee3.png[/img]

notes.title: The Core of Frost
notes.content:
After setting a new record, your character will make a personality move.
Camera added automatic mode, can automatically change the field of view.
Reworked the defensive weapon and renamed it Frostcore. Frostcore can summon walls of icicles to block and destroy enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42780808/062d1c62fe53f618550bdd4030ba54d79cbc46dc.png[/img]

notes.title: Mass Avatar Skin
notes.content:
Greatly increased avatar skin.
In order to avoid excessive size of the game, all skins were split into DLC
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42780808/864bec17e7c4be81cfafd6328704839679559482.png[/img]

notes.title: The Golden Cudgel
notes.content:
Add exercise modules. Practice with three random weapons with three tracks every day
Remade Double-bladed lightsaber (Saberstaff). Attacking with an energy attached end deals critical strike damage
Added The Golden Cudgel skins (Follow WUKONG's skin to unlock)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42780808/e184f5a7bb437ef1296b9298e792e905e247d38f.png[/img]

notes.title: Body Visualization
notes.content:
Add avatar system.
Defeating all cores of the album unlocks the corresponding character skin.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42780808/d1f44079008d8a6ca2dafdce993826906ded2b22.png[/img]

notes.title: Frame Rate Visualization
notes.content:
A lot of frame rate related optimizations and added a lot of efficiency comments to the UI.
Added a widget to test the frame rate, so you can adjust the Settings according to the frame rate.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42780808/a93002495b779e5b492801fb23462944d8599665.png[/img]

notes.title: Play Your Own Map
notes.content:
Added map editor and support for custom music.
Mapping in VR mode, and play with the editing results at any time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42780808/acdb3b106d99c02b7a1ec86835204846eb62366d.png[/img]

notes.title: Saber Ship Demo: Beat the core to win the official version
notes.content:
[b]How to get in: [/b]Return the score and the link to the current game video to the Steam community on this activity.

[b]The way to get the key: [/b]The 5 players with the highest score will be selected after the time is up, and the key will be sent out after adding friends through the Steam community.

[b]Note: [/b]The game process in the video should be intact and the final score should be clearly visible. A player can only get one game key.

notes.title: Black Saber
notes.content:
Added a black saber.
This saber is single-handled and has a sheath, which can enter the void instantaneously under certain maneuvers and ignore incoming lightning.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42780808/ed88aedd26ccb0ddbe326099eda67bbbf1693675.png[/img]

notes.title: Dashboard Upgrade
notes.content:
Through the dashboard module, players can set the game data they want to observe, such as hit score, super energy accumulation, and so on.
This update adds multiple replaceable parts, increases the number of slot locations, and can be scaled in size.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42780808/cc5d0e06fae52c6a1dfc8aa04760708f8910f2cb.png[/img]

notes.title: See Your Play from Multiple Perspectives
notes.content:
Added third person view and spectator camera view.
It is convenient for everyone to observe or record their own game process from multiple perspectives.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42780808/4f8b1b2c077bf1c354faa4bfb0a1fe997637d529.png[/img]

notes.title: Two-Handed Sword
notes.content:
Add a two-handed sword. It can be wielded with one hand, and its power is greatly increased when it is two-handed.
Added option to turn off lightning or linear Ship generation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42780808/71832f6fb8dbe6c357cd7eed1aa0dbae5f873688.png[/img]

notes.title: Real Sabers
notes.content:
Remove weapons that do not look distinctive.
Use the blue lightsaber that can enter the overload state as the initial weapon.
Remove hitting positions that are too far away from the player.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42780808/afbcc10f66d17975057b4d62d99d3faba3055737.png[/img]
